_comment: Save as docs/validation/panel/roster.json. Written by: business-analyst (PANEL mode) from docs/validation/panel/seed-for-roster.md (the seed WITHOUT its hypotheses) and docs/validation/desk-evidence.md. Rules checked by panel.py: 8-30 personas (default 12); every seed segment S-xx present (2+ each, or a thin_segment flag); stance_prior shares: loyal-to-current >= 25%, would-never-buy >= 15%, early-adopter <= 20%; no two personas with the same segment + role + temperament; every persona cites >= 1 desk row id (D-xx) in grounding; any 'voice' quote must appear verbatim in the desk evidence. Keep each persona to a few strong traits: LLM personas collapse to one or two identity dimensions, so long backstories are wasted. Never mention hypotheses or H-xx ids. Enums: budget_authority decides|influences|none; tech_comfort low|medium|high; temperament sceptical|pragmatic|cost-driven|risk-averse|curious|indifferent|impatient; stance_prior loyal-to-current|open|would-never-buy|early-adopter.

personas.job_to_be_done: <what they are trying to get done>
voice: <optional: a quote copied exactly from the desk evidence>
